Distilled from this project's per-prophet deep-dive catalogs, treated here as the source of record. Four of seventeen presidents catalogued so far — more will be added as their reviews complete.

How to read this

Organized like a topical guide: every commandment and promise from every prophet catalogued so far, grouped under the subject it's actually about rather than the sermon it happened to come from. An entry that touches more than one subject — say, a father's duty to pray with his family — appears under each one, the same way a topical guide cross-references a single passage under several headings.

Click any entry to read the full quote, its date and place, and where it was originally given.
